q: O fools, they shall have a Bible; and it shall proceed forth from the Jews, mine ancient covenant people.

s: Bible is not all words of God
q: Wherefore, because that ye have a Bible ye need not suppose that it contains all my words

s: word of the Holy One of Israel is written in books (books written by peoples of the earth)
q: For I command all men, both in the east and in the west, and in the north, and in the south, and in the islands of the sea, that they shall write the words which I speak unto them

s: word of the Holy One of Israel is a standard (for the Lord's people of the house of Israel)
q: my words shall hiss forth unto the ends of the earth, for a standard unto my people, which are of the house of Israel

s: the work of the Lord is a work (the Lord's work among the people)
q: at that day when I shall proceed to do a marvelous work among them

s: the covenants of the Lord are made with children of men (by the Lord)
q: my covenants which I have made unto the children of men

s: the promises of God are made to Nephi (by the Lord)
q: the promises which I have made unto thee, Nephi

s: the promises of God are made to Nephi's father (by the Lord)
q: and also unto thy father

s: Lord God rules the earth (beneath)
q: and that I rule in the heavens above and in the earth beneath

s: nations receive word of the Holy One of Israel (from the Lord, in written form)
q: and I shall also speak unto all nations of the earth and they shall write it.

s: the gathering of Israel and Judah brings home house of Israel (to lands of their possessions)
q: my people, which are of the house of Israel, shall be gathered home unto the lands of their possessions

s: Lord God speaks to nations (all nations of the earth)
q: and I shall also speak unto all nations of the earth and they shall write it.

s: Lord God speaks to Jews
q: For behold, I shall speak unto the Jews and they shall write it

s: Lord God speaks to Nephites
q: and I shall also speak unto the Nephites and they shall write it

s: Lord God speaks to lost tribes of Israel (other tribes of the house of Israel)
q: and I shall also speak unto the other tribes of the house of Israel, which I have led away, and they shall write it

s: Lord God remembers house of Israel (as his people)
q: for I the Lord have not forgotten my people.

s: Nephi is a speaker
q: And now behold, my beloved brethren, I would speak unto you; for I, Nephi, would not suffer that ye should suppose that ye are more righteous than the Gentiles shall be.

s: gospel of Jesus Christ is declared among them
q: And the gospel of Jesus Christ shall be declared among them;

s: the seed of the speaker is restored to knowledge of Jesus Christ
q: wherefore, they shall be restored unto the knowledge of their fathers, and also to the knowledge of Jesus Christ, which was had among their fathers.

s: the seed of the speaker becomes pure and delightsome people (after many generations)
q: and many generations shall not pass away among them, save they shall be a pure and delightsome people.

s: Jews are scattered scattered
q: And it shall come to pass that the Jews which are scattered also shall begin to believe in Christ;

s: Jews believe in Jesus Christ (as they begin to gather)
q: And it shall come to pass that the Jews which are scattered also shall begin to believe in Christ;

s: Jews become delightsome people (if they believe in Christ)
q: and as many as shall believe in Christ shall also become a delightsome people.

s: the Lord commences restoration of his people upon the earth (among all nations, kindreds, tongues, and people)
q: And it shall come to pass that the Lord God shall commence his work among all nations, kindreds, tongues, and people, to bring about the restoration of his people upon the earth.

s: the Lord judges the poor (with righteousness)
q: And with righteousness shall the Lord God judge the poor,

s: the Lord reproves the meek of the earth (with equity)
q: and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth.

s: the Lord destroys the wicked (by fire if necessary)
q: and the wicked will he destroy; and he will spare his people, yea, even if it so be that he must destroy the wicked by fire.

s: Nephi speaks to beloved brethren
q: And now behold, my beloved brethren, I would speak unto you;

s: the great division among the people is caused by the Lord
q: For the time speedily cometh that the Lord God shall cause a great division among the people,

s: the wicked are destroyed destroyed (by the Lord God)
q: and the wicked will he destroy;

s: the earth is full of knowledge of the Lord (as the waters cover the sea)
q: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord as the waters cover the sea.

s: all nations, kindreds, tongues, and people are made known all things (unto the children of men)
q: Wherefore, the things of all nations shall be made known; yea, all things shall be made known unto the children of men.

s: children of men receive all things (all things revealed)
q: yea, all things shall be made known unto the children of men.

s: children of men have no secret things nothing secret (all secrets are revealed)
q: There is nothing which is secret save it shall be revealed;

s: children of men have no work of darkness no work of darkness (all such works are made manifest in the light)
q: there is no work of darkness save it shall be made manifest in the light;

s: children of men have no sealed things nothing sealed upon the earth (all such things are loosed)
q: and there is nothing which is sealed upon the earth save it shall be loosed.

s: Satan has power over the hearts of the children of men (not for a long time)
q: and Satan shall have power over the hearts of the children of men no more, for a long time.

s: Gentiles can become covenant people of the Lord (if they repent)
q: For behold, I say unto you that as many of the Gentiles as will repent are the covenant people of the Lord;

s: Jews are cast off cast off (if they will not repent)
q: and as many of the Jews as will not repent shall be cast off;

s: the Lord covenants with those that repent and believe in his Son (with none save them)
q: for the Lord covenanteth with none save it be with them that repent and believe in his Son, who is the Holy One of Israel.

s: the book is written to Gentiles
q: For after the book of which I have spoken shall come forth, and be written unto the Gentiles, and sealed up again unto the Lord,

s: the book is sealed up again to the Lord
q: For after the book of which I have spoken shall come forth, and be written unto the Gentiles, and sealed up again unto the Lord,

s: the seed of the speaker is a descendants of the Jews
q: And then shall the remnant of our seed know concerning us, how that we came out from Jerusalem, and that they are descendants of the Jews.

s: the seed of the speaker comes from Jerusalem (through their ancestry)
q: And then shall the remnant of our seed know concerning us, how that we came out from Jerusalem, and that they are descendants of the Jews.

s: Joseph (Lehi's last-born son) is a last-born son (of Lehi)
q: And now I speak unto you, Joseph, my last-born.

s: a choice seer is raised from the fruit of Joseph's loins (by the Lord)
q: A choice seer will I raise up out of the fruit of thy loins;

s: a choice seer is esteemed highly among the fruit of Joseph's loins
q: and he shall be esteemed highly among the fruit of thy loins.

s: a choice seer is commanded to do the promised seer's ministry (for the fruit of Joseph's loins)
q: And unto him will I give commandment that he shall do a work for the fruit of thy loins, his brethren, which shall be of great worth unto them,

s: the promised seer's ministry brings the fruit of Joseph's loins (to knowledge of the covenants made with their fathers)
q: which shall be of great worth unto them, even to the bringing of them to the knowledge of the covenants which I have made with thy fathers.

s: a choice seer does no other work the work of the Lord (except what the Lord commands)
q: And I will give unto him a commandment that he shall do none other work, save the work which I shall command him.

s: a choice seer is great Moses (like unto Moses)
q: And he shall be great like unto Moses, whom I have said I would raise up unto you, to deliver my people, O house of Israel.

s: Moses is raised up to deliver house of Israel (from Egypt)
q: And Moses will I raise up, to deliver thy people out of the land of Egypt.

s: a choice seer has power to bring forth word of the Holy One of Israel (unto the fruit of Joseph's loins)
q: But a seer will I raise up out of the fruit of thy loins; and unto him will I give power to bring forth my word unto the seed of thy loins

s: a choice seer convinces the fruit of Joseph's loins (of the word of the Lord already among them)
q: and not to the bringing forth my word only, saith the Lord, but to the convincing them of my word, which shall have already gone forth among them.

s: the fruit of Joseph's loins writes the writing
q: Wherefore, the fruit of thy loins shall write;

s: Joseph (Lehi's last-born son) is born in the wilderness (during Lehi's afflictions)
q: Thou wast born in the wilderness of mine afflictions; yea, in the days of my greatest sorrow did thy mother bear thee.

s: the fruit of Judah's loins writes the writing
q: and the fruit of the loins of Judah shall write;

s: the written records of Joseph's descendants and Judah's descendants grow together the writing (unto the confounding of false doctrines and laying down of contentions)
q: and that which shall be written by the fruit of thy loins, and also that which shall be written by the fruit of the loins of Judah, shall grow together, unto the confounding of false doctrines and laying down of contentions,

s: the written records of Joseph's descendants and Judah's descendants establish peace (among the fruit of Joseph's loins)
q: and establishing peace among the fruit of thy loins,

s: the written records of Joseph's descendants and Judah's descendants bring to knowledge the covenants of the Lord (in the latter days)
q: and bringing them to the knowledge of their fathers in the latter days, and also to the knowledge of my covenants, saith the Lord.

s: a choice seer is blessed by the Lord
q: Behold, that seer will the Lord bless;

s: a choice seer is protected from those who seek to destroy him (they shall be confounded)
q: and they that seek to destroy him shall be confounded;

s: a choice seer is named after Joseph (Lehi's last-born son) (and after his father)
q: And his name shall be called after me; and it shall be after the name of his father.

s: a choice seer brings salvation (through the power of the Lord)
q: for the thing, which the Lord shall bring forth by his hand, by the power of the Lord shall bring my people unto salvation.

s: the Lord preserves the fruit of Joseph's loins (forever)
q: for the Lord hath said unto me, I will preserve thy seed forever.

s: Joseph (Lehi's last-born son) has inheritance lands of promise (with his brethren and conditionally upon keeping the commandments)
q: And may the Lord consecrate also unto thee this land, which is a most precious land, for thine inheritance and the inheritance of thy seed with thy brethren, for thy security forever, if it so be that ye shall keep the commandments of the Holy One of Israel.

s: the Lord raises up Moses
q: And the Lord hath said: I will raise up a Moses;

s: Moses has the rod (as a source of power)
q: and I will give power unto him in a rod;

s: Moses has the law (written by the finger of the Lord)
q: But I will write unto him my law, by the finger of mine own hand;
